title: A table of sales channels
prompt: Reports need a small table that explains each sales channel. Write `solve()` so it builds this table with `spark.createDataFrame` and returns it.
rules: Three columns, in this order: `channel` (text), `label` (text) and `delivery_days` (a whole number of type `int`).
Text is exact: `Mobile app`, not `mobile app`.
hints: Write each row as a tuple, like `("web", "Website", 3)`, and put the three tuples in a list.
The schema is one string that names each column and its type, separated by commas.
Without a schema Spark guesses `bigint` for whole numbers. Say `delivery_days INT` to get `int`.
